about.text: A lamb of butter for the Easter table of Catholics in Poland, Slovenia and Russia, for Christ, the Lamb of God, its red ribbon and banner for his blood. Polish immigrants took it to Buffalo, New York, where it is sold every Easter at the Broadway Market.
